keyEvents.text: Goal! Atalanta 0, Parma 1. Giovanni Fabbian (Parma) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Vincent Sierro with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Parma. Abdoulaye Ndiaye replaces Dominik Drobnic.
Own Goal by Davide Zappacosta, Atalanta. Atalanta 0, Parma 2.
Goal! Atalanta 0, Parma 3. Simone Lontani (Parma) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Giovanni Fabbian.
Substitution, Atalanta. Eljif Elmas replaces Éderson.
Substitution, Atalanta. Kamaldeen Sulemana replaces Jonathan Rowe.
Substitution, Parma. Christian Ordóñez replaces Simone Lontani.
Substitution, Parma. Nesta Elphege replaces El Bilal Touré.
Substitution, Parma. Matija Frigan replaces Giovanni Fabbian.
Substitution, Atalanta. Lazar Samardzic replaces Nicola Zalewski.
Substitution, Atalanta. Javison Idele replaces Davide Zappacosta.
Substitution, Parma. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia replaces Vincent Sierro.
